The isolated service attempts its own path access and separately receives a verified read-only map FD. Denied access is not proof of hiding. Root sampling is a separate manual helper run. This app does not request root or install SUMH rules.
Fixtures and evidence stay in this test app’s private data. Export what you need before clearing the test app’s storage or uninstalling it. There is no automatic rule cleanup.
